# G07 — Gnosix GPUI / host adapter research

**Goal:** Read-only inspection of GPUI scene ownership, offscreen texture handoff and authority boundaries. Propose CPU-buffer/GPU-texture adapter and SceneNodeId/SurfaceId mapping risks. Do not change Gnosix or claim an existing stable FFI. E11/E15.

**Write-set exclusive:** `docs/agent-results/blobin-next-01/G07.md` and `experiments/blobin-next-01/G07/**`. The latter is an original private lab, **not blob.in production source**. Do not edit other workers, shared shader code, historical blob.in snapshot, Gnosix or the in.gnu6 engine.

**Gate:** define a minimal adversarial input and reproducible outcome. Record exact source+toolchain, dependency lock, viewport/DPR, hardware when relevant, verification results and a clear unsupported/NOT_RUN path. No invented benchmark or GPU proof. CPU compatibility and identity ownership must be addressed even for GPU-specific work.

**Handoff:** original committed lab code if implemented + one evidence report; declare candidate shared interfaces as proposals; integrator reconciles after all workers finish.
